scope: Six Spanish Google Play descriptions, same international samples used for English/German: Easybrain, Oakever, Brainium, Andoku, Guru, GamoVation. Language parameter hl=es, not independently verified Spain-only copy or market ranking. Prepared for Spanish (Spain), es-ES; es-419 not changed.
method: NFC, lowercase, whitespace collapse, curly apostrophes normalized to straight apostrophes, dash variants to hyphen. Exact contiguous phrase matches delimited by Unicode letters/digits. Accents retained; singular/plural, synonyms and spacing stay separate. Body between Acerca del juego and Última actualización, including public short description; title, tags, reviews, images and linked websites excluded. Nested matches can overlap. Page caching/region can affect results. Full competitor prose not persisted.
